node.statement: Uniform preliminary controls from the registered definitions: there exist universal K>=1 and e_0>0 such that, for every H-CB datum with e<=e_0 and every compatible amplification, (i) ||A dot B||<=K||A||||B||, (ii) K^{-1}||U||<=q_T(U)<=K||U|| for amplified columns U in M_{n,1} tensor S_{T,Q}, (iii) q_P(A dot U)<=K||A||q_T(U), and (iv) ||(Ha^Q_{P,T})_n(A)||_op<=K||A||. These are only coarse uniform bounds; no false 1+O(e) amplified norm identity is asserted.
